name: spring-payment-pci-shield
displayName: PCI Shield for Spring payment services
description: Guardrails for Java/Spring Boot payment services. Flags PAN/CVV in logs and toString(), floating-point money and unsafe BigDecimal rounding right after Claude writes them, and adds skills for idempotent payment endpoints and JPA N+1 hunting. Community-built; not affiliated with Spring or the PCI Security Standards Council.
